decision: Selected the facility coordinate printed in the Oklahoma DEQ Air Quality Division evaluation memorandum for permit 2026-0216-C (OKC2, Facility ID 25431): latitude 35.53351 N, longitude 97.52242 W. It is used as a project locator for the permitted OKC2 facility, not a building footprint or property boundary.
source_literal_coordinate_tokens: Section 9, Township 12N, Range 3W, Oklahoma County, Oklahoma
datum_note: The memorandum states no datum, collection method or accuracy; the decimal degrees are used as WGS 84 without transformation (NAD83 and WGS 84 differ by about 1 m here, far below the unknown positional uncertainty).

consistency_checks.plss_section: BLM CadNSDI PLSS service: the point lies in Section 09, T12N, R3W of the Indian Meridian (PLSSID OK170120N0030W0, FRSTDIVID OK170120N0030W0SN090), as the memorandum and the 21 September 2026 DEQ letter state; aliquot part NE/4 NW/4 (40 acres).
consistency_checks.position_in_section: about 42% from the west and 77% from the south edge of the section polygon (section bounds -97.5299 to -97.5120, 35.5223 to 35.5369), i.e. in the northern part of the section, consistent with a 6000-block address south of the section's north line
consistency_checks.directions: The memorandum's directions (west on I-44 from I-235, Western Ave exit, east on NW Grand Blvd/I-44 service road, north on N Shartel Ave 0.3 miles, facility on the right) place the site on the east side of N Shartel Ave north of I-44, consistent with the applicant's name, 6000 N Shartel Ave, LLC.
consistency_checks.facility_identity: The 23 July 2026 memorandum (2026-0216-C) and the 21 September 2026 letter (MAC000520) share facility name OKC2, Facility ID 25431, SIC 7374 / NAICS 518210 and Section 9, T12N, R3W.

alternatives_rejected: City of Oklahoma City GIS (gis.okc.gov): returned an Incapsula bot challenge; not pursued, so no parcel polygon was used.
Oklahoma County Assessor site: robots.txt returned HTTP 403; not accessed.
Census TIGERweb: request rejected; not used. No geocoder was used.
